principles.history_use: Historical/teacher pattern match supports interpretation and confidence but never overrides a failed line-level hard gate.
principles.ground_truth_vs_generated: Teacher expectation and generated-line audit are reported separately.
principles.break_rule: Structural break requires a later closed-bar close beyond the relevant level; wick-only penetration is not a confirmed break.
principles.no_line_rule: After an active TL breaks, do not promote the next TL until valid pivots, anchors, structure and required break evidence exist.
principles.cross_tf_rule: source_tf and owner/display_tf are separate concepts; lower-timeframe structure may be displayed on a higher timeframe only when ownership evidence supports it.
principles.supersession_rule: When later reviewed Ground Truth explicitly supersedes an older probe interpretation, retain both records and mark the older interpretation superseded rather than silently deleting it.
principles.ownership_fallback_rule: When an ownership artifact explicitly marks a line ambiguous, source_tf visibility fallback remains HOLD and must not be interpreted as confirmed local ownership.

teacher_cases.probe_note: NVT5 teacher-window probe found zero exact window matches; this is diagnostic HOLD, not a hard anchor lock.

patterns.name: PERSISTENT_REFERENCE_RETAINED
patterns.meaning: A long-retained monitoring TL may remain the correct reference even when a newer geometric re-anchor exists.

patterns.name: VALID_SUPPRESSED_TURN_LINE
patterns.meaning: A structurally valid small-Dow TURN_LINE may be intentionally suppressed because it is steep/short-lived and would clutter the chart.

patterns.name: GENTLER_VALID_ALTERNATIVE_PREFERENCE
patterns.meaning: Among several structurally valid lines, prefer the gentler line when teacher evidence explicitly establishes that selection preference.

patterns.name: TEACHER_WINDOW_ABSENT_DIAGNOSTIC
patterns.meaning: Reviewed approximate teacher anchor windows contain no candidate. Because exact anchors are not locked, treat this as a diagnostic HOLD rather than hard BAD.

patterns.name: PARENT_NO_LINE_LOWER_TF_OWNERSHIP
patterns.meaning: Zero TL on the parent timeframe can be correct when the internal wave line structurally belongs to the lower timeframe.

patterns.name: LOCAL_OWNER_CONFIRMED
patterns.meaning: Explicit ownership evidence confirms that the TL belongs to its source timeframe; source_tf fallback alone does not qualify.

stage_1_policy.teacher_case_replay: Report teacher expectation separately from generated-line Quality
stage_1_policy.ownership_join: Explicit ownership adjudication is joined after per-line structural evidence. Ambiguous ownership produces HOLD without making the underlying TL structurally BAD.
